trace_method: Read the visible theory strokes from the source PDF vector paths, separate from experimental circles; retain every second path vertex plus endpoints and local extrema. Affine-map PDF point coordinates to printed axes. No model output was used.
uncertainty_method: reading_error=0.020 for each point, a conservative visual-reading bound: half of the 0.953-pt stroke corresponds to about 0.009 in Sigma; remaining allowance covers tick calibration, vector export, and marker overlap. This is not a statistical fit error.
coordinate_system: Vector path coordinates in PDF points, origin at lower left; the SVG applies matrix(1,0,0,-1,0,792).

axis_calibration.formula: mass = mass_min + (x - x_min) * (mass_max - mass_min)/(x_max - x_min); Sigma = (y - sigma_zero_y)/((sigma_plus_0_4_y - sigma_minus_0_4_y)/0.8). Shared column and row anchors calibrate each of the twelve panels.

vector_paths.3:p_eta: SVG root child 554, clipped child path

ambiguous_omissions: None: the PDF vector paths preserve the theory stroke independently of overlaid experimental symbols. The CSV contains no experimental marker coordinates and no extrapolation beyond stroke endpoints.

review.reviewer: Codex visual review (not independent human review)
review.method: Compared the 600-dpi source page and 4-by-3 unconnected-marker review PDF, panel by panel, using identical mass and Sigma axes.
review.result: All twelve traced strokes match the published curve extents, signs, and extrema. In particular, the top p_eta panel crosses zero twice; lower-row p_eta and eta_pi0 curves retain their negative minima and rising right edges. No experimental circles or extrapolated segments were included.
